turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’ve been in home hospice, and lately I’ve felt very confused and can’t always get my thoughts together. I’ve also had a higher temperature and some discomfort in my right upper abdomen.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any change in the shape or contour of either breast—such as one becoming noticeably different in size, shape, or position compared with before? (Yes or no)
Have you been feeling generally weak or run-down more than usual lately (for example, lacking energy or feeling unusually tired)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Yes, I’ve felt more weak and run-down than usual, like I don’t have my normal energy. I’ve also been tired and it’s been harder to think clearly.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had diarrhea recently (loose or watery stools)?
Are you having **profuse sweating**—so much that it soaks through your clothes or drips noticeably, even when you’re not doing strenuous activity?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not having profuse sweating like that—nothing that’s soaking my clothes or dripping noticeably.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your wrist? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t have pain in my wrist. I’ve mostly been feeling confused and weak, with a higher temperature and some discomfort in my right upper abdomen.

turns.doctor_question: Do you usually have morning stiffness that lasts **more than 30 minutes** after you wake up? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t usually have morning stiffness that lasts that long after I wake up.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a breast lump or mass that feels **fixed in place**—meaning it doesn’t move much when you gently press it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any breast lump or mass that feels fixed in place. I mostly just feel more confused, very weak, and I’ve had a higher temperature with discomfort in my right upper abdomen.

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have any pain in your knee (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t currently have pain in my knee. I’ve mostly been feeling very confused, very weak, and I’ve had a higher temperature with discomfort in my right upper abdomen.

turns.doctor_question: When you walk, do you get pain or cramping in your calf that improves or goes away when you stop and rest? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: Patient: I don’t know that—I haven’t really been able to walk or notice any calf cramping, because I’ve mostly been too weak and confused lately.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **firm, hard lump or mass in your thigh** that feels different from the surrounding tissue? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed a firm or hard lump in my thigh. I’ve mainly been feeling more confused and very weak, with a higher temperature and discomfort in my right upper abdomen.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Have you noticed any vision loss that happened without pain** (for example, blurry vision or loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by eye pain)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any vision loss or changes like blurry vision or loss of sight. I’ve mainly just been confused and very weak, with a higher temperature and discomfort in my right upper abdomen.”
